SC_001.prompt: Start: A 32-year-old Vietnamese woman (CHAR_LINH) in casual home clothes sits at a dusty storage desk holding an old grey feature phone. Action: Her hands plug the thin cylindrical charging pin into the base of the phone; after a two-second pause, the LCD screen suddenly flickers on. Camera: Macro close-up on her hands and the phone screen as the pale blue backlight illuminates her fingers. End: Linh raises the phone toward her eyes with startled curiosity. Domestic storage room lighting.
SC_001.recommendation_reason: Hook hành động thực tế (Điểm 7/10): Linh cắm sạc cho chiếc điện thoại Nokia cũ, màn hình nhấp nháy sáng bừng sau hơn mười năm.

SC_008.prompt: Start: Close macro view of Linh's hand holding the vintage grey Nokia phone. Action: Her thumb slowly presses the central navigation key; the low-resolution color screen scrolls through photo filenames until an image opens. Camera: Macro focus on the screen as the 2012 hospital image loads pixel by pixel under her thumb. End: The photo is fully displayed, her thumb freezing in place as her hand slightly trembles. Warm desk lamplight.
SC_008.recommendation_reason: Hành động kịch tính (Điểm 9/10): Tiếng chìa khóa xoay cửa đột ngột, Linh giật mình vội vàng giấu chiếc điện thoại Nokia dưới tập tài liệu trước khi Nam bước vào.

SC_014.prompt: Start: A 32-year-old Vietnamese woman (CHAR_LINH) stands in front of the vintage desk in the storage room. Action: She slowly slides the wooden desk drawer all the way open, carefully moving aside old certificates and student notebooks. Camera: Overhead medium close-up tracking into the opening drawer. End: Her hand discovers a small red velvet drawstring pouch tucked in the back corner. Consistent warm storage lighting.
SC_014.recommendation_reason: Tương tác tâm lý căng thẳng (Điểm 8/10): Bữa cơm tối đầy im lặng gượng gạo, Nam tránh ánh mắt của Linh khi với tay lấy cốc nước, sự nghi ngờ âm thầm dâng cao.

SC_019.prompt: Start: An intercity passenger coach pulls up to a bus stop near Nam Định provincial hospital. Action: Linh (32, female) in an olive trench coat steps down from the bus carrying her shoulder bag, walking purposefully down the street toward the hospital gate. Camera: Medium tracking shot following her stride past provincial shops and motorbikes. End: She pauses before the hospital entrance sign, taking a steadying breath. Overcast daylight.
SC_019.recommendation_reason: Chuyển động điều tra thực địa (Điểm 8/10): Camera tracking theo bước chân Linh đi dọc hành lang Bệnh viện Đa khoa Nam Định tấp nập, tìm kiếm manh mối quá khứ.

SC_023.prompt: Start: Linh (32, female) walks down a quiet narrow village lane lined with weathered brick walls in suburban Nam Định. Action: She reaches a small rusted iron gate, pushes it open with a soft metallic creak, and steps into the quiet overgrown courtyard. Camera: Low tracking shot moving forward with her, showing the mossy bricks and rustic single-story house facade. End: She walks up to the wooden front door, pausing respectfully before turning the latch. Soft misty daylight.
SC_023.recommendation_reason: Hành động khám phá thực địa (Điểm 7/10): Linh mở cánh cửa tủ gỗ kẽo kẹt trong căn nhà vắng, với tay tìm thấy chiếc hộp thiếc kỷ vật bám bụi.

SC_024.prompt: Start: Linh (32, female) steps quietly into a dimly lit rural bedroom where dust motes float in shafts of sunlight. Action: She approaches the wooden writing desk, gently lifts the lid of a tin keepsake box, and reveals stacked old letters and documents. Camera: Medium shot panning down from her respectful face to her hands lifting the box lid. End: Her fingers carefully touch an official notarized legal paper inside. Warm diffused window light.
SC_024.recommendation_reason: Hành động lật mở chứng cứ (Điểm 7/10): Tay Linh run rẩy mở nắp hộp thiếc, nhấc từng phong bì và biên bản bảo lãnh có tên Nam ra xem.

SC_038.prompt: Start: Nam (35, male) enters the apartment carrying his work bag, stopping dead in his tracks. Action: Linh (32, female) stands up slowly from the dining table where the old phone and silver bracelet rest; she looks at him with moist, earnest eyes. Camera: Medium two-shot steadily pushing in toward Nam as his bag slips from his hand and his face turns pale. End: Nam takes a trembling step forward, his voice choked. Intimate warm evening domestic lighting.
SC_038.recommendation_reason: Đỉnh điểm kịch tính đối đầu (Điểm 9/10): Linh đặt hồ sơ và kỷ vật lên bàn chất vấn, Nam quỳ sụp xuống ôm mặt bật khóc trong giải tỏa và ân hận.

SC_044.prompt: Start: Linh (32, female), Nam (35, male), and 11-year-old An walk side by side along an urban park pathway beside a lake. Action: An skips cheerfully between them holding both their hands; Nam looks down at An with a joyful smile, while Linh exchanges a loving look with Nam. Camera: Wide tracking shot moving backwards ahead of the three, framing them against shimmering lake water and golden trees. End: They continue walking into the soft golden sunset. Warm, tranquil golden hour lighting.
SC_044.recommendation_reason: Hành động kết thúc giàu ý nghĩa (Điểm 10/10): Bé An chạy lại ôm chầm lấy Nam và Linh trên con đường ngập nắng chiều công viên, giải tỏa trọn vẹn nỗi đau 10 năm.
